title: Shamans' accounts of little men out of a big light (Passport to Magonia)

tellings.quote: say by the way the shaman also told me 50 years ago they were little men who came out of a big light

plain: Shamans in places like the Pacific and Siberia have long described "little men who came out of a big light", according to the computer scientist and UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. He recalls a shaman telling him this fifty years ago, and ties it to his book Passport to Magonia, which compares modern UFO stories with old folklore. The point is that today's encounters may echo far older ones.
